purpose: Stable character-creation endpoints for skills explicitly awarded through the initial fighting-style choice.

endpoints.name: CaC Creation — Mixed Fighting Style
endpoints.route: Initial CaC creation: select the Mixed fighting style.
endpoints.notes: Starting-character creation endpoint. Super Guard also has a Skill Shop route, which remains represented by the shop endpoint layer; this endpoint records the distinct starting route.

endpoints.name: CaC Creation — Close-Range Fighting Style
endpoints.route: Initial CaC creation: select the close-range fighting style ('I want to fight up close').
endpoints.notes: Starting-character creation endpoint. Super Guard also has a Skill Shop route, which remains represented by the shop endpoint layer; this endpoint records the distinct starting route.

evidence_policy: This layer records the starting route only. It does not suppress alternate legitimate acquisition routes such as Super Guard's Skill Shop availability.
